source.paraphrase: The content scanner only sees full class names written literally in source files. Concatenated or interpolated fragments are invisible to it, so the utilities are never generated.

invariants.why: Constructing fragments can hide utility candidates, but concatenating complete literal class names leaves those candidates visible to the scanner.
invariants.fixHint: Write the full class names as literals, or pass literals to clsx/cn with a boolean condition.
invariants.avoid: clsx with a prebuilt dynamic string is still dynamic. Only literal arguments count. The expression must be inside a className or class attribute, or the value of a className or class property. A string built in a helper function or a variable and passed in later is not matched.

source.paraphrase: Prefixing a utility with ! forces it to win by importance instead of by the cascade the design system relies on.

invariants.why: Important utilities paper over specificity conflicts instead of fixing them, and each one raises the cost of the next override.
invariants.fixHint: Remove the ! prefix and reorder the utilities or restructure the selectors so the cascade resolves the conflict.
invariants.avoid: Moving the bang behind a variant prefix (md:!) is still the important modifier.

source.work: Tailwind CSS documentation, theme and arbitrary values
source.paraphrase: Colors belong in the theme so every surface shares one palette. A hardcoded hex in an arbitrary value bypasses the theme and forks the palette.

invariants.why: One-off hex values scatter the palette across files, so a rebrand or dark-mode pass has to hunt down literals instead of changing tokens.
invariants.fixHint: Replace the hex with the closest theme color utility, or add the color to the theme and use its token.
invariants.avoid: Shortening the hex to 3 digits does not make it a token. bg-[red] without a hex is the named escape hatch, not this pattern. A hex in stored data, a theme-color meta value, or any string outside a className or class attribute and outside a clsx, cn, cx, classnames, twMerge, twJoin, cva or tv call is not an arbitrary class value.

source.paraphrase: Tailwind scans source text. Complete class literals remain detectable even when an array joins them at runtime.

invariants.why: The call shape cannot distinguish full utility literals (safe) from fragments (unsafe).
invariants.fixHint: Replace the array and .join with a clsx/cn call whose arguments are full class literals.
invariants.avoid: Joining an array of pure literals is still a join. The scanner contract is on the call shape, not the contents.

source.paraphrase: The content scanner reads the entire source file, including definitions of class-name variables.

invariants.why: A reference alone cannot prove a missing utility; the variable may hold full literal class names visible elsewhere in source.
invariants.fixHint: Inline the literal classes at the call site, or wrap them in clsx/cn with literal arguments.
invariants.avoid: A member expression such as styles.card or props.className is still fully dynamic to the scanner.

relations.why: React Native styles components through the style prop; without NativeWind there is no className to move the style into.
relations.settle: Turn TW-STYLE-001 off for React Native code, or adopt NativeWind and keep it.

source.paraphrase: Styling belongs in utilities so spacing, color, and responsive behavior stay in one system. Inline style objects split the design into two authorities.

invariants.why: A style object bypasses the theme, variants, and content pipeline, so the rule it encodes cannot respond to design tokens or breakpoints.
invariants.fixHint: Replace the style object with the matching utility class; keep style only for values utilities cannot express.
invariants.avoid: A computed custom-property key is still an inline style object, not a utility.

source.locator: Changes from v3: removed deprecated utilities
source.paraphrase: v4 removes utilities deprecated in v3: bg-, text-, border-, divide-, ring- and placeholder-opacity-*, flex-shrink-*, flex-grow-*, overflow-ellipsis and decoration-slice/clone. Use opacity modifiers like bg-black/50, shrink-*, grow-*, text-ellipsis and box-decoration-slice/clone.

invariants.why: Tailwind v4 generates no CSS for these names, so the element silently loses its opacity, flex sizing or truncation.
invariants.fixHint: Use the color opacity modifier (bg-black/50, text-white/75), grow and shrink, text-ellipsis, or box-decoration-slice and box-decoration-clone.
invariants.avoid: Only string literals inside className or class attributes and clsx, cn, cx, classnames, twMerge, twJoin, cva or tv calls are read; variant and ! prefixes are included. backdrop-opacity-*, opacity-*, grow and shrink pass. Warn only: on Tailwind v3 these names still work.

source.work: Tailwind CSS documentation, adding custom styles, https://tailwindcss.com/docs/adding-custom-styles
source.paraphrase: When an arbitrary value needs a space, use an underscore instead and Tailwind converts it to a space at build time.

invariants.why: Class lists split on whitespace, so grid-cols-[1fr 2fr] becomes the two invalid classes grid-cols-[1fr and 2fr] and no style is generated.
invariants.fixHint: Replace each space inside the brackets with an underscore, for example grid-cols-[1fr_2fr] or w-[calc(100%-2rem)]. Use \_ for a literal underscore.
invariants.avoid: Only string literals inside className or class attributes and clsx, cn, cx, classnames, twMerge, twJoin, cva or tv calls are read. Brackets in titles, labels and other strings pass. Values split across a template substitution are not seen.

source.work: Tailwind CSS documentation, Styling with utility classes (https://tailwindcss.com/docs/styling-with-utility-classes)
source.paraphrase: Utility classes style elements directly in className or class attributes; an empty class literal emits an unused empty DOM attribute with no utilities.

invariants.why: An empty className="" or class="" attribute leaves dead markup in the rendered DOM and usually signals an incomplete refactor or missing utility string.
invariants.fixHint: Delete the empty className/class attribute, or add the intended Tailwind utility classes.
invariants.avoid: Only literal empty strings ("" or '') directly in className/class or wrapped in braces className={""} are matched. Dynamic expressions like clsx(...) pass.
